adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, in `handleNewBooking`, can append additional team members’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), but when persisting the booking it still connects only the first one (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`). Later flows in the diff build `CalendarEvent` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (a single relation) wrapped into a 1-item array (e.g. cancel/confirm/editLocation/webhooks), so the extra computed destinations are not recoverable from persisted booking state. However, whether this is a defect is not fully verifiable from the diff because update/delete logic is also refactored to operate over multiple calendar references (filtering `references` and iterating), which may be the intended source of truth for per-calendar operations, reducing the impact to an architectural/consistency concern and edge-case fallbacks.
